staticContract.sourcePrecondition: ascending, non-empty int[]; the source assumes the array is sorted and does not define an empty-array guard
staticContract.intervalInvariant: closed inclusive candidate interval [lo, hi], with lo = 0 and hi = a.length - 1
staticContract.progress: key > a[mid] advances lo to mid + 1; otherwise hi becomes mid; while (lo < hi) converges to a singleton
staticContract.duplicateBehavior: returns the smallest index containing key when duplicates exist
staticContract.missingBehavior: returns -1 after the final equality check
staticContract.emptyBehavior: empty input reaches a[lo] with lo = 0 after hi = -1 and raises Java's array-bounds exception
staticContract.complexity: O(log n) comparisons under the stated precondition
staticContract.mutation: does not modify the input array
staticContract.languageBoundary: Java int is signed 32-bit; this static slice does not claim Python/JavaScript equivalence, overflow emulation, or exception-class equivalence
